attackers_goals: Adversaries may use SID history to escalate privileges and bypass access controls.
description: A user added SID history to an account. This may be indicative of a user's migration between domains or a SID injection attack.
investigative_actions: Verify if migration between domains was involved. Search for suspicious actions by the user, such as forged Kerberos tickets.
name: User added SID History to an account
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)

variations.name: Suspicious SID History Addition
variations.description: A user added SID history to an account. The account was not migrated between domains, which may indicate a SID injection attack.
variations.attackers_goals: Adversaries may use SID history to escalate privileges and bypass access controls.
variations.investigative_actions: Verify if migration between domains was involved. Search for suspicious actions by the user, such as forged Kerberos tickets.
